description: Looks up Amazon products. With asin it returns one product (asin, title, brand, price, availability, rating, reviews_count, url, image); with query, up to 20 results from the first search page (title, url, asin, price, rating, reviews_count, position). Send asin or query, not both; marketplace selects the Amazon site (default com). It does not return reviews, offers, bestseller lists or price history, nor prices from other merchants (use google_shopping_prices). A search with no matches is charged; errors are not. Required: asin or query.

asin.description: Amazon product ID (ASIN), exactly 10 letters or digits, e.g. "B00CH9QWOU", for one product. Send asin or query, not both.

marketplace.description: Amazon site as its domain suffix, e.g. "com" for amazon.com, "co.uk" or "it". Omit for com.

query.description: Product search text, 1-500 characters, e.g. "espresso machine". Send query or asin, not both.

results.description: Maximum search results returned for query, integer 1-20, default 10, e.g. 5. Not used with asin.

name: amazon_product
title: Amazon Product
